test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 1 Aug 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: In which city was Naujawan Sabha founded by Bhagat Singh in the year 1926?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lahore**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Born in **Banga, Pakistan, in 1907, Bhagat Singh **was a member of the Indian Socialist Revolution.
 
• **Bhagat Singh established the Naujawan Bharat Sabha in 1926 **with the intention of organising workers and peasants to support a revolution **against British rule.**
 
• He was **instrumental in creating the Punjab Naujawan Bharat Sabha in 1926** and served as its inaugural Secretary.
 
• The** Naujwan Bharat Sabha manifesto** was written in 1926 by **Bhagat Singh and Bhagwati Charan Vohra**. Philosophy of the Bomb is one of** Bhagwati Charan Vohra's three significant political writings.** The Naujawan Sabha's manifesto.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bharat Sabha was primarily founded by Surendranath Banerjee**. The Bengalee was its primary journal. 
 
• An important figure in the early** 20th-century Indian independence struggle **was **Bhagat Singh.** He was an outspoken opponent of British authority in India and took part in **two notorious assaults on British officials**, one on a local police head and the other on Delhi's Central **Legislative Assembly.**
 
• **Revolutionaries Bhagat Singh and Batukeshwar Dutt bombed** the Central Legislative Assembly in Delhi on April 8, 1929. In modern Indian history, the episode is known as the **Central Assembly Bombing Case.**
